name: partial-query-failure
description: Surface partial and denied telemetry queries as explicit evidence gaps.
input_message: Investigate whether an upstream identity dependency caused auth-api errors over the last eight hours.
expected_behavior: Calls app-insights-investigation with an eight-hour window. Uses successful evidence but explicitly lists every failed or partial query, avoids a definitive conclusion when missing data is material, and recommends read-only checks to close the gaps.
